# GPU Programming & CUDA

**Understand why GPUs are fast and write your own kernels: CUDA basics, memory, tiled matmul, Triton, and FlashAttention.**

Level: **Advanced** · 11 steps · 11h 37m of video · Prerequisites: Deep Learning (PyTorch and attention basics). C or C++ basics help. Needs an NVIDIA GPU or a free Colab GPU.

[Track your progress on the website](https://gruheshkurra.github.io/awesome-ai-roadmaps/gpu-programming-and-cuda/) · [All roadmaps](../README.md)

## Build it

- Write a vector add and a naive matmul in CUDA, then add tiling and chart the speedup.
- Implement a fused softmax in Triton and benchmark it against PyTorch.
- Profile one PyTorch model layer, find its bottleneck, and write up what you changed.
